0022600019.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 1-0 on the road, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home, 5th in the East) in the Magic's fifth game of the season, with Orlando coming in on a one-game winning streak and Toronto on a one-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture).
